pr_comments:
Hi @sanchit-gandhi @amyeroberts, this PR fixes an issue with TFLite conversion of TFWhisper models. However, the cause of the bug was that our forced decoding logits processor sets unwanted logits to `-inf`, and that breaks TFLite. This PR uses `-10000.` instead, which should be within the `float16` representable range.

The output of the sampling before and after this PR should be the same, because a logit of `-10000` will yield a probability of 0 after softmax at any precision. However, it does create a difference in the logits between Torch and TF. This doesn't seem to break any of our cross-tests, though, even when I ran the slow ones locally.

As such, I think this is safe to merge, and I'll double-check with @dsame that it fixes the issue. Let me know if you're opposed, though!

The docs for this PR live [here](https://moon-ci-docs.huggingface.co/docs/transformers/pr_32301). All of your documentation changes will be reflected on that endpoint. The docs are available until 30 days after the last update.
Ah! Given @sanchit-gandhi's comment, we probably shouldn't merge this PR - instead we should try to refactor the TF generation to not use forced decoder IDs, which avoids the problem entirely.

issue_context.title: TF Lite model created from TFWhisperForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained craches
issue_context.body:
### System Info

The main branch still does not include the fix:
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/19691#issuecomment-1791869884

namely
```
    #new_scores = tf.ones_like(scores, dtype=scores.dtype) * -float("inf")
    new_scores = tf.ones_like(scores, dtype=scores.dtype) * -float(1)
```

which causes TFLite Whisper model to crash when used as:
```
    interpreter = tf.lite.Interpreter(tflite_model_path)
    tflite_generate = interpreter.get_signature_runner()
    output = tflite_generate(input_features=input_features)
```

### Who can help?

 @ArthurZucker


### Information

- [ ] The official example scripts
- [X] My own modified scripts

### Tasks

- [ ] An officially supported task in the `examples` folder (such as GLUE/SQuAD, ...)
- [X] My own task or dataset (give details below)

### Reproduction

```
class GenerateModel(tf.Module):
    def __init__(self, model, forced_decoder_ids):
        super(GenerateModel, self).__init__()
        self.model = model
        self.forced_decoder_ids = forced_decoder_ids

    @tf.function(
        # shouldn't need static batch size, but throws exception without it (needs to be fixed)
        input_signature=[
            tf.TensorSpec((1, 80, 3000), tf.float32, name="input_features"),
        ],
    )
    def serving(self, input_features):
        outputs = self.model.generate(
            input_features,
            forced_decoder_ids=self.forced_decoder_ids,
            #max_new_tokens=223,  # change as needed
            return_dict_in_generate=True,
        )
        return {"sequences": outputs["sequences"]}

model = TFWhisperForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(model_name)
generate_model = GenerateModel(model=model, forced_decoder_ids=forced_decoder_ids)
tf.saved_model.save(generate_model, saved_model_dir, signatures={"serving_default": generate_model.serving})

# Convert the model
converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_saved_model(saved_model_dir)
converter.target_spec.supported_ops = [
        tf.lite.OpsSet.TFLITE_BUILTINS,  # enable TensorFlow Lite ops.
        tf.lite.OpsSet.SELECT_TF_OPS  # enable TensorFlow ops.
]

converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]
tflite_model = converter.convert()

# Save the model
with open(tflite_model_path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(tflite_model)

....
    interpreter = tf.lite.Interpreter(tflite_model_path)
    tflite_generate = interpreter.get_signature_runner()
    output = tflite_generate(input_features=input_features)
```

causes crache on tflite_generate.

Applying the patch https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/19691#issuecomment-1791869884 solves the problem

### Expected behavior

The code below should work without patch

```

        self.model = model

        input_signature=[
            tf.TensorSpec((1, 80, 3000), tf.float32, name="input_features"),
        ],
    )
    def serving(self, input_features):
        outputs = self.model.generate(
            input_features,
            forced_decoder_ids=self.forced_decoder_ids,
            #max_new_tokens=223,  # change as needed
            return_dict_in_generate=True,
        )
        return {"sequences": outputs["sequences"]}

model = TFWhisperForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(model_name)
generate_model = GenerateModel(model=model, forced_decoder_ids=forced_decoder_ids)
tf.saved_model.save(generate_model, saved_model_dir, signatures={"serving_default": generate_model.serving})

# Convert the model
converter = tf.lite.TFLiteConverter.from_saved_model(saved_model_dir)
converter.target_spec.supported_ops = [
        tf.lite.OpsSet.TFLITE_BUILTINS,  # enable TensorFlow Lite ops.
        tf.lite.OpsSet.SELECT_TF_OPS  # enable TensorFlow ops.
]

converter.optimizations = [tf.lite.Optimize.DEFAULT]
tflite_model = converter.convert()

# Save the model
with open(tflite_model_path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(tflite_model)

....
    interpreter = tf.lite.Interpreter(tflite_model_path)
    tflite_generate = interpreter.get_signature_runner()
    output = tflite_generate(input_features=input_features)
```
